mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% indicate robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.0% annually) signals robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO growth > 1.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A rising payroll employment level (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer income and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, triggering monetary policy tightening and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5%) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) growth exceeding 0.3% indicate strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.3% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.3% in 1 quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates full-capacity manufacturing activity, signaling sustained economic growth and positive corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0.
